question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having alphabets 'M' to 'R'. Find the alphabet on the face opposite the face showing 'M'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26e865e4c1768028b58eb3b5fea529c9c44a995c9e020a65107973b06049eba5.png]
solution:
